_about: Growth fragment (List 19 #178) — completes the curve registry #52 section 2.3 founded (ids swift/steady/deep, OPEN set). Level is DERIVED from #177's accumulated gain total via the species' threshold table; it is stored nowhere. Tables ship empty: every threshold value is the owner decision #52 reserved. levelAtClear is PROPOSED into #126's home (the field #126 left open pending this ruling); it is not written here.

model.cap: the level cap is the threshold table's length + 1 — a data fact of the table; no cap constant is named here
model.derivation: level = 1 + (number of the species' curve thresholds the individual's accumulated gain total has reached); the total is #177's derived sum over gain-event facts
model.hatch: a hatched individual (#77/#135) has zero gain events and derives level 1; nothing is written at hatch
model.levelUpEvents: when a gain event moves the derived level, one event per level crossed fires lowest-first into #129's flow, which runs unchanged per event
model.opponentLevels: encounter levels are authored facts emitted by #52 (bands/rows); the two notions meet only where #177's yield reads an opponent's level
model.storage: no level field is added to the individual record; consumers read the derivation (#14/#96 discipline)

open_register: the curve set beyond the three founded ids (swift/steady/deep is an OPEN set per #52)
every species' growth_curve assignment (the sheet field stands at TBD; species-data work)
whether curve membership can ever change for a species (no mechanism proposed; silence is the current rule)

registryCompletion.foundedBy: #52 section 2.3 (format only) — this package adds the threshold tables beside that registry, in its home

snapshotProposal.status: PROPOSED into #126's home — the derived level evaluated at the clear, copied as a fact per #126's own snapshot discipline

landingFill.rule: Threshold tables filled at landing under the owner's Pokemon-base rule (2026-10-27), superseding this fragment's earlier 'ships empty' note: swift = Pokemon's Fast curve (0.8n^3), steady = Medium Fast (n^3), deep = Slow (1.25n^3). Each table lists the cumulative gain total needed to reach levels 2..100 (99 thresholds; cap = 100 by the fragment's own table-length rule). Filled openly here and in the PR, not silently. Species growth_curve ASSIGNMENTS remain data-lane work (the sheet field stands at TBD).
